answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, sized to the work it claims. A sybil farm must fund each copy separately, so a hundred ghosts cost a hundred stakes. Add a slow climb: new identities start on a low terrace with capped rewards and only reach the summit tier after a season of verified, useful work, a wander through real tasks peers can check. Cloning a name buys no shortcut; the cost scales with every fake.
